title: It runs, but there's no picture
ticket: A gaming PC came back from a repair shop. The fans spin, but the monitor says No Signal. The graphics card was taken out and put back.

tasks.text: The graphics card has its 8-pin power cable.
tasks.hint: 1 long and 3 short beeps, and the VGA light: video. Check the card's spec card: does it need power from the PSU?

tasks.text: The monitor is plugged into the graphics card.
tasks.hint: This CPU is an F model: no graphics of its own, so the motherboard's video port shows nothing.

tasks.text: It starts Windows, with a picture.
tasks.hint: Both of the above, then power on.
